response.justification: Bogdan is a highly experienced full-stack engineer with 14+ years of diverse experience spanning frontend, backend, embedded, and infrastructure work, well exceeding the 6+ years requirement. He has direct, current experience with TypeScript/Node.js and AI-agent development (MCP frameworks), which directly matches two key requirements. While he lacks explicit mentions of Nest.js, Vitest, Kotlin, and PostgreSQL, his breadth across many languages (D, Java, C#, PHP, Swift) and frameworks suggests strong adaptability to fill these gaps quickly.
strengths: Extensive full-stack experience (14+ years) across web, mobile, and backend systems with proven TypeScript/Node.js/React expertise
Direct hands-on experience with AI-agent infrastructure and MCP framework development, a specifically required skill
Strong engineering culture fit: TDD, CI/CD, pair programming, open-source leadership, and teaching/mentoring experience
concerns: No explicit experience listed with Nest.js, Vitest, or Kotlin/Java in a backend service context relevant to the role
Cloud platform and container orchestration experience appears limited (brief AWS CDK mention, Kubernetes only for personal project)
Frequent job changes (many roles under 2 years) could raise questions about retention, though partly offset by long tenures at Optilyz and re:cinq
